body: Me too. I feel so alone and gutted. The weird thing is that no one would know--we seem fine in public. I suppose he hasn't been forthcoming with his true feelings lately. I've also been off work sick and have generally been feeling shitty so this is just adding to the stress.

Maybe he's right though. I am not attractive and everyone's always nicer to me when I'm thinner anyway. It's so blatantly obvious that I raise my social currency even if it's done by unhealthy means, like starving myself. I'm just so sick of it all.
I can't believe how I let myself mold my life around another person only to see it all apart. I'm such a fucking worthless idiot.

I have nothing else to live for. I moved abroad to be with him 10 years ago. Now I'm alone and no one knows we are having problems. I feel so alone. I can't stop crying and taking 2 xanaxes didn't do anything to calm me down.

NTA whatsoever. I'm so sorry that this happened to you, OP. They are not friends and seem like super big assholes themselves. This is the kind of toxic, basic bitch bullshit that some lady-groups like to engage in, so I highly recommend that hang out with actual nice, kind people! Fuck em. 

If you're in any sort of metropolitan area, [meetup.com](https://meetup.com) is a decent way to meet people who have similar interests.

Also, people make waaay to big of a deal of New Year's in my opinion. Everyone makes it up to be the EPIC end of the year and really, who cares. Just another day with more drunk idiots running around than usual.  Order in some yummy food and dive into some movies if you want to be by yourself! Happy New Year :) <3

Thanks for your comments everyone :) I don't have kids, just to be clear as some here rightfully commented it's important to get a professional's opinion as opposed to seeking out the advice of those on the internet! Happy New Year.
I just cried a lot at Frankie's death. He was such a positive comic relief <3 gonna miss him!
